class: When local runs are limited to the test files a change is 'about' (to save a shared host's CPU), a test in another file that pins the changed behaviour - a status code, a redirect, a message code, a route shape - is skipped, so the change looks green locally and the first full run in CI fails; the selection must be driven by a search for every changed route, code and message across both test trees, not by file names.
mechanism: Issue #163 changed the Kite login callback's refusals from a 403 JSON body to a 302 redirect. The builder, both reviewers and the orchestrator ran tests_app/test_kite_login.py, test_error_logging.py, test_error_boundary_scan.py and test_api_models.py (137 passed); tests_app/test_broker_token_store.py:458 still asserted (403, render('broker_user_mismatch').as_dict()) and only CI's full app suite ran it.

first_seen.where: PR #176 (fix/163-refusal-redirect @ de62820), CI run 38018869688 job api
first_seen.evidence: CI: '1 failed, 1072 passed, 3 skipped' - JSONDecodeError on refused.json() at test_broker_token_store.py:458; locally after updating the assertion: test_broker_token_store.py + test_kite_login.py 150 passed; a grep of tests/ and tests_app/ for the callback path and every refusal code found no other dependent test.

fix: Instance: the assertion now expects the 302 to /broker/refused?code=broker_user_mismatch with no body (session-row checks unchanged). Class mechanism: a quality-bar line in docs/process/builder-brief.md - before the targeted run, grep tests/ and tests_app/ for every route, status, code and message the change touches and add every file that names one to the run. Second occurrence (L2 mechanism): atool.py --no-tests runs every tests_app file that touches migrations through db_run whenever the branch changes alembic/versions (on PR #183: 11 files, 755 passed); round-trip tests share tests_app/_migration_replay.py, which undoes every later migration first, so a new migration no longer breaks older round-trip tests.

detection.note: The general case (any changed behaviour pinned by a test in an unrelated file) is still caught only by CI's full suite, by design on the VPS; the migration case is now caught locally.

occurrences.evidence: one CI round (api job ~1.5 min) lost

CI api job: 1 failed, 1186 passed - tests_app/test_history_pg_store.py's 0009 round-trip test replayed 0009's downgrade assuming 0009 was head; with 0010 on top the allowlist 'post' check refused ('ofo_strategy_definition_valid body differs from its pinned body'). The builder had grepped by function/table name; a migration's dependents are every test that walks the chain.
